001package io.github.ai4ci;
002
003import java.io.File;
004import java.io.IOException;
005import java.nio.file.Files;
006import java.nio.file.Path;
007import java.nio.file.Paths;
008import java.util.Arrays;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.stream.Collectors;
011
012import org.apache.commons.cli.CommandLine;
013import org.apache.commons.cli.CommandLineParser;
014import org.apache.commons.cli.Converter;
015import org.apache.commons.cli.DefaultParser;
016import org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter;
017import org.apache.commons.cli.Option;
018import org.apache.commons.cli.Options;
019import org.apache.commons.cli.ParseException;
020import org.apache.commons.lang3.SystemUtils;
021import org.apache.logging.log4j.Level;
022import org.mariuszgromada.math.mxparser.License;
023
024import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude.Include;
025import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser;
026import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
027import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.SerializationFeature;
028import com.fasterxml.jackson.datatype.guava.GuavaModule;
029
030import io.github.ai4ci.config.ExperimentConfiguration;
031import io.github.ai4ci.example.Experiment;
032import io.github.ai4ci.flow.SimulationMonitor;
033
034/**
035 * Command-line entry for the simulator and a small launcher used by batch
036 * systems.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * This class exposes a simple CLI for running experiments. Options accepted by
040 * the main method are:
041 *
042 * <ul>
043 * <li><b>-o, --output &lt;output&gt;</b> — Path to the output directory.
044 * Defaults to the current working directory. A leading <code>~</code> is
045 * expanded to the invoking user's home directory.</li>
046 * <li><b>-c, --config &lt;config&gt;</b> — Path to the configuration JSON file.
047 * By default the launcher looks for <code>config.json</code> in the output
048 * directory.</li>
049 * <li><b>-g, --generate-config &lt;generate-config&gt;</b> — generates a
050 * default configuration</li>
051 * <li><b>-v, --validate-config &lt;validate-config&gt;</b> — parses a
052 * configuration file and displays a summary if successful</li>
053 * </ul>
054 *
055 * Behaviour notes:
056 * <ul>
057 * <li>If the output directory does not exist it will be created (or a
058 * RuntimeException is raised if creation fails).</li>
059 * <li>If the configuration file cannot be found a RuntimeException is
060 * raised.</li>
061 * <li>On CLI parse errors the program prints usage help and exits (status 0) —
062 * see the printed help for SLURM usage hints.</li>
063 * </ul>
064 *
065 * <p>
066 * The launcher integrates with SLURM workflows by accepting continuous batch
067 * array parameters; see the usage help printed by the program for an example
068 * invocation. For programmatic callers use {@link SimulationMonitor} and
069 * {@link ExperimentConfiguration#readConfig(Path)} directly.
070 */
071public class JPanSim2 {
072
073        private static Path expand(Path path) {
074                if (path.startsWith("~" + File.separator)) {
075                        path = Paths.get(
076                                System.getProperty("user.home"),
077                                path.toString()
078                                        .substring(1)
079                        );
080                }
081                return path;
082        }
083
084        /**
085         * The main entry point for a command line or SLURM batch job.
086         *
087         * @throws InterruptedException if the simulation is interrupted by the user
088         *                              or a batch system signal. The simulation will
089         *                              attempt to save progress before exiting when
090         *                              interrupted.
091         * @throws IOException          if the output directory cannot be created or
092         *                              the configuration file cannot be read.
093         * @param args the command line arguments; see the class-level Javadoc for
094         *             accepted options and usage notes.
095         */
096        public static void main(String... args)
097                        throws IOException, InterruptedException {
098
099                License.iConfirmNonCommercialUse("rob.challen@bristol.ac.uk");
100
101                var dir = SystemUtils.getUserDir()
102                        .toPath();
103                Path configFile = null;
104
105                Experiment experiment = null;
106
107                // define options via CLI
108                var options = new Options();
109
110                var outputPath = Option.builder("o")
111                        .longOpt("output")
112                        .argName("output")
113                        .hasArg(true)
114                        .converter(Converter.PATH)
115                        .desc(
116                                "The path to the output directory. Defaults to the current working directory."
117                        )
118                        .required(false)
119                        .build();
120
121                var configPath = Option.builder("c")
122                        .longOpt("config")
123                        .argName("config")
124                        .hasArg(true)
125                        .converter(Converter.PATH)
126                        .desc(
127                                "The path to the configuration file. Defaults to \"config.json\" in the output directory."
128                        )
129                        .required(false)
130                        .build();
131
132                var configs = Arrays.stream(Experiment.values())
133                        .map(v -> v.name)
134                        .collect(Collectors.joining(",", "'", "'"));
135
136                var generateConfigName = Option.builder("g")
137                        .longOpt("generate-config")
138                        .argName("generate-config")
139                        .hasArg(true)
140                        .type(String.class)
141                        .desc("The example configuration name to generate. One of: " + configs)
142                        .required(false)
143                        .build();
144
145                var validateConfig = Option.builder("v")
146                        .longOpt("validate-config")
147                        .argName("validate-config")
148                        .type(String.class)
149                        .optionalArg(true)
150                        .desc("Parse the config file and make sure it is valid")
151                        .required(false)
152                        .build();
153
154                var validate = false;
155                Class<?> validateClz = ExperimentConfiguration.class;
156
157                options.addOption(outputPath);
158                options.addOption(configPath);
159                options.addOption(generateConfigName);
160                options.addOption(validateConfig);
161                // define parser
162                CommandLine cmd;
163                CommandLineParser parser = new DefaultParser();
164                var helper = new HelpFormatter();
165
166                try {
167                        cmd = parser.parse(options, args);
168
169                        if (cmd.hasOption(outputPath)) {
170                                var tmp = expand(cmd.getParsedOptionValue(outputPath));
171                                dir = tmp;
172                        }
173
174                        if (cmd.hasOption(generateConfigName)) {
175                                var tmp = cmd.getParsedOptionValue(generateConfigName)
176                                        .toString();
177                                experiment = Arrays.stream(Experiment.values())
178                                        .filter(v -> v.name.equalsIgnoreCase(tmp))
179                                        .findFirst()
180                                        .orElseThrow(
181                                                () -> new RuntimeException(
182                                                                "Couldn't find experiment: " + generateConfigName
183                                                )
184                                        );
185                        }
186
187                        if (cmd.hasOption(configPath)) {
188                                var tmp = expand(cmd.getParsedOptionValue(configPath));
189                                configFile = tmp;
190                        } else {
191                                configFile = null;
192                        }
193
194                        if (cmd.hasOption(validateConfig)) {
195                                validate = true;
196                                var validateClzName = cmd.getOptionValue(validateConfig);
197                                if (validateClzName == null) {
198                                        validateClz = ExperimentConfiguration.class;
199                                } else {
200                                        try {
201                                                validateClz = Class.forName(validateClzName);
202                                        } catch (ClassNotFoundException e) {
203                                                throw new ParseException(
204                                                                "Class does not exist: " + validateClzName
205                                                );
206                                        }
207                                }
208
209                                if (!ENTRY_POINTS.contains(validateClz)) throw new ParseException(
210                                                "Invalid config classname: " + validateClz.getCanonicalName()
211                                                                + " must be one of:\n" + ENTRY_POINTS.stream()
212                                                                        .map(Class::getCanonicalName)
213                                                                        .collect(Collectors.joining("\n"))
214                                );
215                        }
216
217                } catch (ParseException e) {
218                        System.out.println(e.getMessage());
219                        helper.printHelp(
220                                "Usage:",
221                                "JPanSim2 command line options.",
222                                options,
223                                "Slurm support: batch commands must be continuous and start at 1\n"
224                                                + "e.g. sbatch --array=1-32"
225                        );
226                        System.exit(0);
227                }
228                // finish configuration using CLI
229
230                try {
231                        Files.createDirectories(dir);
232                } catch (IOException e) {
233                        throw new RuntimeException(
234                                        "Could not create output directory at: " + dir
235                        );
236                }
237
238                if (validate) {
239
240                        var om = new ObjectMapper();
241                        om.enable(SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT);
242                        om.enable(JsonParser.Feature.ALLOW_COMMENTS);
243                        om.registerModules(new GuavaModule());
244                        om.setDefaultPropertyInclusion(Include.NON_NULL);
245                        // om.setSerializationInclusion(Include.NON_NULL);
246                        System.out.println("================================");
247                        System.out.println("Testing " + validateClz.getCanonicalName());
248                        try {
249                                Object rt;
250                                if (configFile != null) {
251                                        System.out.println("From file: " + configFile.toString());
252                                        rt = om.readerFor(validateClz)
253                                                .readValue(configFile.toFile());
254                                } else {
255                                        System.out.println("From stdin.");
256                                        rt = om.readerFor(validateClz)
257                                                .readValue(System.in);
258                                }
259                                System.out.println("================================");
260                                System.out.println("Configuration parsed OK.");
261                                System.out.println(
262                                        "Identified as: " + rt.getClass()
263                                                .getCanonicalName()
264                                );
265                                System.out.println("================================");
266                                System.out.println(rt.toString());
267                                System.out.println("================================");
268                                System.out.println("SUCCESS");
269                                System.exit(0);
270                        } catch (IOException e) {
271                                System.out.println("================================");
272                                System.out.println("Configuration failed to parse.");
273                                System.out.println("================================");
274                                System.out.println(e.getMessage());
275                                System.out.println("================================");
276                                System.out.println("FAILURE");
277                                throw new RuntimeException(e);
278                        }
279                }
280
281                if (configFile == null) { configFile = dir.resolve("config.json"); }
282                if (!Files.exists(configFile)) {
283                        if (experiment == null) throw new RuntimeException(
284                                        "Could not find configuration at: " + configFile
285                        );
286                        experiment.config.writeConfig(configFile, false);
287                        System.out.println(
288                                String.format(
289                                        "Writing example configuration '%s' to file: %s",
290                                        experiment.name,
291                                        configFile
292                                )
293                        );
294                        System.exit(0);
295                }
296
297                var conf = ExperimentConfiguration.readConfig(configFile);
298
299                // Common SLURM options
300                SlurmAwareLogger.setupLogger(conf, dir, Level.INFO, Level.DEBUG);
301                var runner = new SimulationMonitor(conf, dir);
302                runner.run();
303
304        }
305
306        private static List<Class<?>> ENTRY_POINTS = Arrays.asList(
307                ExperimentConfiguration.class,
308                io.github.ai4ci.config.BatchConfiguration.class,
309                io.github.ai4ci.config.ExecutionFacet.class,
310                io.github.ai4ci.config.SetupFacet.class,
311                io.github.ai4ci.config.TestParameters.class,
312                io.github.ai4ci.config.setup.SetupConfiguration.class,
313                io.github.ai4ci.config.setup.DemographicConfiguration.class,
314                io.github.ai4ci.config.setup.NetworkConfiguration.class,
315                io.github.ai4ci.config.execution.ExecutionConfiguration.class,
316                io.github.ai4ci.config.inhost.InHostConfiguration.class
317        );
318
319}
